speaker: Will
text: The Marshal says the surface is lost. He's never been up to check.

speaker: Will
text: Lamp four is out again. We've written to Cinderhold. Twice.

speaker: Will
text: Eleven years since anyone saw the sky. I don't remember what blue looks like.

speaker: Will
text: Ash in the soup. Ash in the bread. Ash in my boots.

speaker: Will
text: My grandfather told me about rain. I think he made it up.

speaker: Will
text: The fans hum all day. You stop hearing them. Then they stop and you panic.

speaker: Will
text: Slagford's got the good mushrooms. Cinderhold's got the good gossip.

speaker: Will
text: They say the Chancellor never sleeps. I believe it.

speaker: Will
text: We patch the tanks with the tanks. Not many tanks left.

speaker: Will
text: Breathing filter's clogged again. Bang it on the wall. There.

speaker: Will
text: Lava's quiet today. I don't trust it when it's quiet.

speaker: Will
text: I traded my ration for a book. Best trade I ever made.

speaker: Will
text: The old roads go up. Nobody walks them anymore.

speaker: Will
text: Someone painted a sun on the bunker wall. Looks nice. Looks wrong.

speaker: Will
text: Night, day. Down here they're the same colour.

speaker: Will
text: Lamps are dimmed. That's how we know it's night.

speaker: Will
text: Lava glow through the slits. Better than a candle.

speaker: Will
text: Eleven years since anyone saw the sky. You've come from it, haven't you?

speaker: Will
text: A stranger! From above!

speaker: Will
text: Up there! On the ridge!

speaker: Will
text: Intruder in the vault! Signal the line!

speaker: Will
text: Who goes there? Halt!

speaker: Will
text: Surface man! Get him!

speaker: Will
text: Hold the line! For the Vault!

speaker: Will
text: Through the smoke! He's there!

speaker: Will
text: Call in the guns!

speaker: Will
text: Keep him out of the trenches!

speaker: Will
text: Get to the wire! Don't let him past!

speaker: Will
text: Mortar team! Mark him!

speaker: Will
text: Pin him in the ash!

speaker: Will
text: Check the trenches.

speaker: Will
text: Follow the prints in the ash.

speaker: Will
text: Check the bunker. Then the next one.

speaker: Will
text: He's somewhere in the smoke.

speaker: Will
text: Gone into the haze.

speaker: Will
text: Lost him in the ash. Report to Cinderhold.

speaker: Will
text: The vault swallows people. Maybe it swallowed him.

speaker: Will
text: I'm hit! Ah!

speaker: Will
text: My filter! He broke my filter!

speaker: Will
text: Medic to the line!

speaker: Will
text: Back to the bunker!

speaker: Will
text: Fall back to the Ember Line!

speaker: Will
text: Don't shoot! Take me up there! Show me the sky!

speaker: Will
text: I yield! I'm tired of the dark!

speaker: Will
text: Is it... blue? Up there?

speaker: Will
text: Tell Cinderhold... lamp four...

speaker: Will
text: They found another tunnel. It goes down. They always go down.

speaker: Will
text: The lamp oil smells like burned hair. You get used to it.

speaker: Will
text: Someone hums a surface song. Nobody knows the words anymore.

speaker: Will
text: The boiler boys say the pipes are singing. That's never good.

speaker: Will
text: Cinderhold's market had a real apple. One. People queued.

speaker: Will
text: My boots melted a little on the slag road. Again.

speaker: Will
text: We used to dream about leaving. Now we dream about sleeping.

speaker: Will
text: The Marshal inspects the trenches at night. Nobody knows when he sleeps.

speaker: Will
text: Mark him! Mark him for the guns!

speaker: Will
text: Hold the trench!

speaker: Will
text: Up and over! Push!

speaker: Will
text: Keep your mask on, keep firing!

speaker: River
text: Sixty days on this ice and the coffee still tastes like the tin it came in.

speaker: River
text: Supply sled's late. If it's not here by dark we start rationing jokes.

speaker: River
text: Uplink's been fine all week. Which means it's planning something.

speaker: River
text: Someone left the hatch open. Again. The snow came in to say hello.

speaker: River
text: My beard has icicles. My eyebrows have icicles.

speaker: River
text: The generator's the warmest thing on this station. I talk to it.

speaker: River
text: Chess with the radio operator. He cheats. I let him.

speaker: River
text: Saw lights over the ridge last night. Probably nothing. Probably.

speaker: River
text: Six weeks to rotation. Not that I'm counting. Forty-one days.

speaker: River
text: The rail line's the only thing that comes on time out here.

speaker: River
text: Who ate the last tin of peaches? I'm conducting an investigation.

speaker: River
text: Ice on the dish again. Somebody grab the broom.

speaker: River
text: Lights stay on all night. You'd think that'd help me sleep.

speaker: River
text: Wind's howling. Sounds like it's got a grudge.

speaker: River
text: Keep the stove going. If it dies, we die.

speaker: River
text: Night on the ice. Black as a boot.

speaker: River
text: Contact on the ramp!

speaker: River
text: Intruder at the station! Sound it!

speaker: River
text: Someone's at the bulkheads!

speaker: River
text: There! On the ice!

speaker: River
text: Alarm! Get everyone up!

speaker: River
text: Into the trucks! Cover the road!

speaker: River
text: Hold the stairwell!

speaker: River
text: Seal the bulkheads behind you!

speaker: River
text: Pin him in the hall!

speaker: River
text: Protect the uplink!

speaker: River
text: Cover the generator! If he gets there we're done!

speaker: River
text: Go, go! Down the stairs!

speaker: River
text: Check the generator hall.

speaker: River
text: Check the control room. Twice.

speaker: River
text: He came down the stairwell. Follow the snow.

speaker: River
text: Look in the lockers.

speaker: River
text: Gone into the snow. We'll never track him in this.

speaker: River
text: Lost him. Close the hatches.

speaker: River
text: He'll freeze out there. Probably.

speaker: River
text: I'm hit! Ah, it's cold!

speaker: River
text: Took one! Help!

speaker: River
text: Get me to the medical bay!

speaker: River
text: Back down the stairs!

speaker: River
text: Into the bunker! Seal it!

speaker: River
text: They sent us a crate of oranges. Froze solid. Still the best day this month.

speaker: River
text: Wrote a song about the snow. It's short. It's mostly swearing.

speaker: River
text: The cook says it's stew. The thermometer says it's ice.

speaker: River
text: Rail crew says the line's buried again. Shovels out.

speaker: River
text: Saw a polar fox. It looked at me like I owed it money.

speaker: River
text: My socks have been wet for three weeks.

speaker: River
text: The radio picked up music last night. Somewhere it's warm.

speaker: River
text: I've counted every rivet in the control room. Twice.

speaker: River
text: Watch the ice, it's slick!

speaker: River
text: Keep him off the ramp!

speaker: River
text: Get behind the truck!

speaker: River
text: Hold here! Hold!

speaker: Bill
text: Sharpened my axe. Sharpened it again. Nothing else to do.

speaker: Bill
text: Boss counts the gold twice a day. I count it once, quieter.

speaker: Bill
text: This Roost has more rats than brigands.

speaker: Bill
text: Rained in the hall. Through the roof. On my supper.

speaker: Bill
text: Somebody stole my stolen boots.

speaker: Bill
text: Quiet in the woods. Too quiet for honest folk. Lucky we're not honest.

speaker: Bill
text: Toll road, friend. Pay in coin or pay in blood. We take both.

speaker: Bill
text: Hey! Intruder! Axes up!

speaker: Bill
text: Fresh one! Grab him!

speaker: Bill
text: You lost, traveller?

speaker: Bill
text: Chop him down!

speaker: Bill
text: Surround him!

speaker: Bill
text: Swing low! Take his legs!

speaker: Bill
text: Don't let him get to the stairs!

speaker: Bill
text: That's it? My horse bites harder.

speaker: Bill
text: Come closer. I don't bite. The axe does.

speaker: Bill
text: Run, little rabbit!

speaker: Bill
text: Ow! You'll pay for that!

speaker: Bill
text: Argh! Cut me, did you?

speaker: Bill
text: That'll scar!

speaker: Bill
text: Run! Run for the woods!

speaker: Bill
text: Every man for himself!

speaker: Bill
text: Tell the boss... tell him I kept the gold.

speaker: Bill
text: Shoulda... been a farmer...

speaker: Bill
text: Somebody sang in the hall last night. Somebody should stop.

speaker: Bill
text: My axe has a name. I won't tell you.

speaker: Bill
text: Roost leaks worse than a sieve.

speaker: Bill
text: Boss wants the ledger tidy. Brigands with ledgers. What's the world coming to?

speaker: Bill
text: Hack at him!

speaker: Bill
text: Get round the back!

speaker: Bill
text: Keep him in the corner!

speaker: Bill
text: Stranger at the gate! Grab your axes!

speaker: Bill
text: Somebody's poking round the Roost!

speaker: Adam
text: Stand straight, eyes forward, think about lunch. That's guard duty.

speaker: Adam
text: Third inspection this week. They'll polish the paint off.

speaker: Adam
text: My boots were issued in spring. They still haven't forgiven me.

speaker: Adam
text: Sergeant says the parade's on. Sergeant says a lot of things.

speaker: Adam
text: If the tram's late again I'm walking the wall. Faster anyway.

speaker: Adam
text: Mess hall's doing the grey stew. Every day is grey stew day.

speaker: Adam
text: Wrote my sister. Told her it's all marble and banners. It's mostly stairs.

speaker: Adam
text: They painted the gate again. Same colour. Different number.

speaker: Adam
text: You hear the drill hall echo? That's my knees.

speaker: Adam
text: Two more years and I get a desk. A desk with a chair.

speaker: Adam
text: Who keeps leaving oil rags in the stairwell?

speaker: Adam
text: I volunteered for the tower. I'd like to un-volunteer.

speaker: Adam
text: The new rifles shoot straighter. The new boots don't walk straighter.

speaker: Adam
text: Somebody fed the pigeons on the battlements. Now they think they live here.

speaker: Adam
text: Watch rotation's posted. I'm on nights. Again.

speaker: Adam
text: I miss the farm. The cows never asked for my papers.

speaker: Adam
text: Officer's got a new hat. We're all supposed to notice the hat.

speaker: Adam
text: Quiet shift. Don't say it out loud.

speaker: Adam
text: Some fool sneezed during the anthem. They're still looking for him.

speaker: Adam
text: Lamp oil ration's down a third. Polishing by moonlight, then.

speaker: Adam
text: Night watch. The stars don't salute, at least.

speaker: Adam
text: Cold up here. Wall's colder.

speaker: Adam
text: Lamps out on the east side. Again.

speaker: Adam
text: If I fall asleep on the wall, the wall can report me.

speaker: Adam
text: Somewhere a bed has my name on it.

speaker: Adam
text: Quiet night. I hate quiet nights.

speaker: Adam
text: Papers, please. And keep your hands where I can see them.

speaker: Adam
text: No weapons drawn inside the walls, citizen.

speaker: Adam
text: Move along. Nothing to see but me.

speaker: Adam
text: Gate closes at dusk. Don't be on the wrong side of it.

speaker: Adam
text: State your business with the Capital.

speaker: Adam
text: Keep to the main road. Side streets are for residents.

speaker: Adam
text: Holster that weapon inside the walls, citizen. I won't ask twice.

speaker: Adam
text: Show your pass at the inner gate.

speaker: Adam
text: Intruder! Inside the wall!

speaker: Adam
text: There! By the steps! Open fire!

speaker: Adam
text: Contact! Sound the bell!

speaker: Adam
text: Halt! You're not cleared for this sector!

speaker: Adam
text: Armed stranger, west side! Get him!

speaker: Adam
text: Hold it right there! Down on the ground!

speaker: Adam
text: We've got a runner! Cut him off!

speaker: Adam
text: Alarm! Alarm! Shooter on the grounds!

speaker: Adam
text: Movement in the garden! That's no gardener!

speaker: Adam
text: He's here! Wake the barracks!

speaker: Adam
text: Contact on the east wall! Get the gun crew up!

speaker: Adam
text: Keep him pinned! Don't let him reach the tower!

speaker: Adam
text: Covering! Move up!

speaker: Adam
text: Push left! Push left!

speaker: Adam
text: Short bursts! Make them count!

speaker: Adam
text: He's behind the planter! Flush him out!

speaker: Adam
text: For the Capital! Forward!

speaker: Adam
text: Hold the stairs! Nobody gets past the landing!

speaker: Adam
text: Grenade! Get down!

speaker: Adam
text: Pour it on! He can't hide forever!

speaker: Adam
text: Somebody get eyes on the roof!

speaker: Adam
text: Stay in cover, you idiot!

speaker: Adam
text: Reload behind the pillar, I've got you!

speaker: Adam
text: He's quick! Lead your shots!

speaker: Adam
text: Fall in on me! Line up!

speaker: Adam
text: Check the halls. Every door.

speaker: Adam
text: Spread out. He can't have gone far.

speaker: Adam
text: Look behind the crates. Look under them too.

speaker: Adam
text: Two by two. Nobody wanders off alone.

speaker: Adam
text: I heard boots on the stairs. Up, now.

speaker: Adam
text: Check the gardens. He likes cover.

speaker: Adam
text: Search the barracks. Wake whoever's sleeping.

speaker: Adam
text: He's in here somewhere. I can feel it.

speaker: Adam
text: Lost him. He was right here.

speaker: Adam
text: Gone. Like smoke.

speaker: Adam
text: Stand down... but keep your eyes open.

speaker: Adam
text: Report it. Somebody's getting a lecture.

speaker: Adam
text: Probably a rat with a rifle. Back to posts.

speaker: Adam
text: We'll find him. Or he'll find us.

speaker: Adam
text: That was the wall! Somebody's inside!

speaker: Adam
text: Breach! Breach on the lower level!

speaker: Adam
text: They've blown the door! Positions!

speaker: Adam
text: Something just came through the stone! Move!

speaker: Adam
text: Wall's open! Get everyone down here!

speaker: Adam
text: Reloading!

speaker: Adam
text: Changing mags, cover me!

speaker: Adam
text: Empty! Cover!

speaker: Adam
text: Last clip! Somebody bring rounds!

speaker: Adam
text: Hold on, hold on, I'm dry!

speaker: Adam
text: I'm hit! Leg's gone numb. Keep firing!

speaker: Adam
text: Ah! He got my arm!

speaker: Adam
text: Medic! Medic!

speaker: Adam
text: I'm bleeding! Somebody!

speaker: Adam
text: Just a scratch! Just a big scratch!

speaker: Adam
text: Argh! That one went through!

speaker: Adam
text: Fall back! Fall back to the hall!

speaker: Adam
text: Too hot! Pull back!

speaker: Adam
text: I'm not dying on these steps! Back!

speaker: Adam
text: Get to the barracks! Regroup!

speaker: Adam
text: All right! All right! I yield!

speaker: Adam
text: Don't shoot! I've got a family!

speaker: Adam
text: I'm done! I'm done! Let me go!

speaker: Adam
text: You picked the wrong wall to climb.

speaker: Adam
text: The whole garrison's coming. Hope you brought friends.

speaker: Adam
text: Nobody storms the Capital and walks home.

speaker: Adam
text: Tell my mother... I kept my boots clean.

speaker: Adam
text: Not... on the stairs...

speaker: Adam
text: Should've... taken the desk...

speaker: Adam
text: They moved the mess hall bell. Half the barracks missed breakfast.

speaker: Adam
text: The quartermaster counts bullets like they're his children.

speaker: Adam
text: Saw the Chancellor's carriage go past. Didn't wave. Neither did I.

speaker: Adam
text: If they double the watch again, we'll be guarding each other.

speaker: Adam
text: Painted my helmet. Got told off. Painted it back.

speaker: Adam
text: There's a cat in the armoury. Nobody admits to feeding it.

speaker: Adam
text: Rumour is there's a bonus at year's end. Rumour is a liar.

speaker: Adam
text: My bunkmate snores like a deck gun.

speaker: Adam
text: They issued us new manuals. Same as the old manuals, thicker.

speaker: Adam
text: Drill at dawn, drill at noon, drill in my sleep.

speaker: Adam
text: I'd swap a week's pay for one quiet Sunday.

speaker: Adam
text: Somebody wrote a poem on the latrine wall. It's quite good.

speaker: Adam
text: Keep the pressure on!

speaker: Adam
text: Watch the left flank!

speaker: Adam
text: He's reloading! Push!

speaker: Adam
text: Get down, get down!

speaker: Adam
text: Eyes on the doorway!

speaker: Adam
text: Cover the courtyard!

speaker: Adam
text: Hit him from both sides!

speaker: Adam
text: Don't stop shooting!

speaker: Adam
text: Stay sharp. He's got to be close.

speaker: Adam
text: Check the stairwell. Then check it again.

speaker: Adam
text: Somebody saw him by the fountain.

speaker: Jessica
text: Smells good, doesn't it?

text: Pull up a stool.

speaker: Jessica
text: Hungry? You came to the right place.

speaker: Jessica
text: Sit anywhere you like.

speaker: Jessica
text: Beans or stew? Both, I'd wager.

speaker: Jessica
text: The secret's in the pepper. Don't tell.

speaker: Jessica
text: Stew's been simmering since dawn.

speaker: Jessica
text: Best cuts in town, right here.

speaker: Jessica
text: Biscuits are fresh out of the oven.

speaker: Jessica
text: Nobody leaves my table hungry.

speaker: Jessica
text: Ran clean out of salt this morning.

speaker: Jessica
text: My mother's recipe. Don't ask for it.

speaker: Jessica
text: Kitchen's closing up.

speaker: Jessica
text: Last call, folks.

speaker: Jessica
text: Come back hungry!

text: Mind the step on your way out.

text: Enjoy it while it's hot.

text: Good choice. That one's my favorite.

text: That's a little more than you've got.

text: Hey, that's somebody's supper!

text: Easy with that thing!

text: Whoa, whoa! Put it down!

text: Kitchen's closed, friend.

text: We're shut. Come back when we open.

text: Ovens are cold. Come back tomorrow.

text: Sit down, sit down. Stew's hot.

text: Welcome! Hungry? You look hungry.

text: Pull up a stool. What'll it be?

speaker: Jessica
text: Ah, a regular! Usual?

speaker: Jessica
text: Smell that? That's supper.

speaker: Jessica
text: Come in, wipe your boots. Please.

speaker: Jessica
text: Plenty of room at the bar.

speaker: Jessica
text: Welcome to the best table in town. Also the only one.

speaker: Jessica
text: Hello! Don't mind the noise, that's just the piano.

speaker: Jessica
text: Burned the bread. Don't tell anyone.

speaker: Jessica
text: We're out of eggs. Chickens are on strike.

speaker: Jessica
text: Who ordered the beans? Nobody? Again?

speaker: Jessica
text: The piano player owes me a week's supper.

speaker: Jessica
text: Best steak this side of the river.

speaker: Jessica
text: Somebody spilled whisky on my clean floor.

speaker: Jessica
text: Cook's secret? More salt.

speaker: Jessica
text: Had a cowboy eat six plates last night. Six!

speaker: Jessica
text: The cellar flooded. Potatoes went for a swim.

speaker: Jessica
text: I'm trying a new pie. Peach. Maybe plum.

speaker: Jessica
text: The town drunk sang all night. Nobody slept.

speaker: Jessica
text: This knife's duller than the sheriff's jokes.

speaker: Jessica
text: We had a brawl Saturday. Lost two chairs.

speaker: Jessica
text: Somebody keeps stealing my pickles.

speaker: Jessica
text: Kitchen's closing, last plates going out.

speaker: Jessica
text: That's the last of the stew.

speaker: Jessica
text: Pianist's gone home. Thank goodness.

speaker: Jessica
text: I'm wiping down. Finish your drink.

speaker: Jessica
text: Bring your appetite next time!

speaker: Jessica
text: Don't let the door hit you.

speaker: Jessica
text: Good night, eat well.

speaker: Jessica
text: Next one's on... well, you.

speaker: Jessica
text: Eat up before it cools.

speaker: Jessica
text: Fresh as it gets.

speaker: Jessica
text: That'll stick to your ribs.

speaker: Jessica
text: Coming right up.

speaker: Jessica
text: No coin, no supper.

speaker: Jessica
text: Kitchen doesn't run on promises.

speaker: Jessica
text: Come back when your pockets jingle.

text: That plate's not paid for!

speaker: Jessica
text: Hey! Put down my pie!

speaker: Jessica
text: Thief in the kitchen!

speaker: Jessica
text: Get out of my kitchen!

speaker: Jessica
text: You're barred! Out!

text: I've got a cleaver and I know how to use it!

speaker: Jessica
text: Ow! Watch it!

speaker: Jessica
text: Help! Somebody stop him!

speaker: Jessica
text: Not the face! I need the face!

speaker: Jessica
text: Take the money! Leave the stew!

speaker: Jessica
text: Easy now! I just cook!

speaker: Jessica
text: Kitchen's cold. Try tomorrow.

text: We're shut, friend. Ovens are out.

speaker: Jessica
text: No more food tonight.

text: Raiders! Into the cellar!

text: Grab a pan and get down!

text: There's a dance on Saturday. You should come.

speaker: Will
text: Heard wolves last night out past the mill.

speaker: Will
text: The schoolteacher's got a cough. Kids are thrilled.

speaker: Will
text: That cloud looks like a horse. No, a pig. A horse-pig.

speaker: Will
text: Our cat brought home a snake. Proud as anything.

speaker: Will
text: My horse throws a shoe every time I go to market.

speaker: Will
text: They're digging a new well behind the chapel.

speaker: Will
text: The bridge creaks. I walk faster on it.

speaker: Will
text: Somebody tried to sell me a map to buried gold. Twice.

speaker: Will
text: Town meeting's on Thursday. Bring a chair.

speaker: Will
text: Best pie in the county is at the saloon. Don't tell the baker.

speaker: Will
text: Heard gunfire up the valley this morning. Hunters, I hope.

speaker: Will
text: They say a soldier deserted and hides in the hills.

speaker: Will
text: My son wants to join the Capital's army. I said eat your beans first.

speaker: Will
text: The well bucket's got a hole. Again.

speaker: Will
text: Watched the sunset last night. Best one all year.

speaker: Will
text: There's a funny smell by the tannery. There always is.

speaker: Will
text: Remember when the barn burned? Nobody's forgotten.

speaker: Will
text: Got a letter from my brother out east. Wants money, of course.

speaker: Will
text: Whoever's playing the piano at night, please stop.

speaker: Will
text: They say there's a vault under the ash plains. I say nonsense.

speaker: Will
text: Saw a man ride through with a rifle as long as he was tall.

speaker: Will
text: The undertaker's been idle. That's a good sign.

speaker: Will
text: My dog only barks at the mailman. Nobody else.

speaker: Will
text: Seed's in. Now we wait and pray for rain.

speaker: Will
text: Fresh paint on the post office. Looks right smart.

speaker: Will
text: They hanged a scarecrow by the road. Scared me too.

speaker: Will
text: Some fellow came through selling tonic. Tasted like boot polish.

speaker: Will
text: Getting old's no fun. Better than the alternative.

speaker: Will
text: If you need a wagon fixed, try the smith. He's slow but good.

speaker: Will
text: Haven't had a quiet week since spring.

speaker: Will
text: Saw the train smoke way off on the plain.

speaker: Will
text: My wife says I talk too much. She's not wrong.

speaker: Will
text: Heard a raid hit a homestead out west. Keep your eyes open.

speaker: Will
text: The church choir's practising. Mind your ears.

speaker: Will
text: Somebody's chickens got loose. The whole street's chasing them.

speaker: Will
text: I owe the barber money. Don't tell him you saw me.

speaker: Will
text: They say the old mine still has silver. They also say it caves in.

speaker: Will
text: Good wood's getting hard to find around here.

speaker: Will
text: Rain's coming. My knee knows.

speaker: Will
text: I had a dream about cake last night. Woke up sad.

speaker: Will
text: Moon's up. Time I wasn't.

speaker: Will
text: Night air's good for thinking. And catching cold.

speaker: Will
text: Hear the crickets? Loud tonight.

speaker: Will
text: Don't wander off the road in the dark.

speaker: Will
text: Lanterns are lit. Town looks pretty this time of night.

speaker: Will
text: Coyotes are singing again.

speaker: Will
text: I'd stay in tonight, if I were you.

speaker: Will
text: Long day. Longer night.

speaker: Will
text: Owls are out. Mice should be in.

speaker: Will
text: Strange shapes in the dark out past the fence.

speaker: Will
text: Keep your lamp trimmed, friend.

speaker: Will
text: The saloon gets rowdy this late.

speaker: Will
text: Folks say things move in the fields at night.

speaker: Will
text: Cold one tonight. Wear a coat.

speaker: Will
text: Off to bed. Wake me if there's a fire.

speaker: Will
text: Another day done. Not a bad one.

speaker: Will
text: The stars out here make you feel small.

speaker: Will
text: Watch for the drunks by the saloon steps.

speaker: Will
text: Dark comes quick this time of year.

speaker: Will
text: Lock up your horse. Thieves love a moonless night.

speaker: Will
text: Go easy now.

speaker: Will
text: Until next time.

speaker: Will
text: Don't be a stranger.

speaker: Will
text: Look after yourself.

speaker: Will
text: Watch for rattlers on the trail.

speaker: Will
text: Good talking with you.

speaker: Will
text: Mind the weather.

speaker: Will
text: Off you go, then.

speaker: Will
text: Keep your powder dry.

speaker: Will
text: Come back in one piece.

speaker: Will
text: Well, I won't keep you.

speaker: Will
text: Ride safe.

speaker: Will
text: Say hello to the road for me.

speaker: Will
text: Take it slow.

speaker: Will
text: Good luck out there.

speaker: Will
text: That's a fair deal.

speaker: Will
text: Pleasure doing business.

speaker: Will
text: You drive a hard bargain.

speaker: Will
text: Thank you kindly.

speaker: Will
text: Done and done.

speaker: Will
text: Not enough there, I'm afraid.

text: Counting's not your strong suit, is it?

speaker: Will
text: That won't cover it.

text: Bit light in the purse today?

text: Hey! That's not yours!

text: I saw that. Hand it back.

text: Thief! Somebody get the sheriff!

speaker: Will
text: Put it down, or I'll holler.

text: You've got some nerve!

text: Get away from me!

speaker: Will
text: I'll remember your face!

text: Hey! Quit it!

text: Are you mad? Stop!

text: Help! Help!

text: Ah! Leave me alone!

text: Whoa, whoa! Steady!

text: I've got nothing, I swear!

text: Generator's coughing again. If it dies on my shift, it's your fault.

text: Ration tins say beef. I've seen beef. That isn't beef.

text: Radio's been nothing but static since Tuesday.

text: Whoever stacked those sandbags has never met a sandbag.

text: Third week on this post. Starting to name the crows.

text: They promised us leave by the harvest. Which harvest, they didn't say.

text: Card game tonight. Bring your own matches to bet.

speaker: Chris
text: Wind keeps getting into the bunker. Wind and sand.

speaker: Chris
text: Supply truck's late. Supply truck's always late.

text: I'd kill for a hot bath. Well. Not kill. Strongly consider.

text: Corporal swears the base is haunted. Corporal also drinks.

text: Lamp in the comms room flickers. Nobody fixes anything here.

text: Did you hear that? No? Good. Me neither.

text: My mum thinks I'm a clerk. Let's keep it that way.

speaker: Chris
text: Who took my tin cup? It had a dent. I liked the dent.

text: Coffee's out. Morale's out with it.

text: Saw a fox at the wire this morning. Prettiest thing out here.

text: If the command post calls, I'm on patrol. I'm always on patrol.

text: Keep the lamp low. Snipers love a lamp.

text: Cold night. Colder in the bunker.

speaker: Chris
text: Watch the ridge. That's where they'd come from.

speaker: Chris
text: Night shift's the worst shift. Every shift's the worst shift.

text: Stars out here are something. Shame about everything else.

speaker: Chris
text: No closer. Not without a pass.

text: Keep moving, traveller. Nothing here for you.

speaker: Chris
text: Keep his head down!

speaker: Chris
text: Look for tracks in the sand.

speaker: Chris
text: Lamps up. He hides in the dark.

speaker: Chris
text: He's still in the base. I'd bet my boots on it.

speaker: Chris
text: Get a squad on the roof. The rest of you, with me.

speaker: Chris
text: Lost him. He was right here. Spread out.

speaker: Chris
text: Gone. Where the devil did he go?

speaker: Chris
text: Back to posts. Stay sharp.

speaker: Chris
text: Probably ran for the hills. Probably.

text: Tell Command we had a visitor. They'll love that.

speaker: Chris
text: That was the wall. Someone's inside. Room by room, go!

text: Wall's down on the east side!

speaker: Chris
text: Explosion in the bunker! Move!

speaker: Chris
text: Somebody just blew a hole in us!

speaker: Chris
text: Reloading!

speaker: Chris
text: Mag out! Cover!

speaker: Chris
text: I'm empty!

speaker: Chris
text: Swapping! Watch the door!

speaker: Chris
text: Argh! I'm hit!

speaker: Chris
text: Took one in the shoulder!

speaker: Chris
text: Medic! Anyone!

speaker: Chris
text: Get him off me!

speaker: Chris
text: That stings like the devil!

speaker: Chris
text: Pull back! Pull back to the bunker!

speaker: Chris
text: He's too good! Get out!

speaker: Chris
text: Run for the trucks!

speaker: Chris
text: All right! All right, I'm going! Don't shoot!

speaker: Chris
text: I give up! I just work the radio!

speaker: Chris
text: Don't shoot! I'm out of this!

speaker: Chris
text: You'll never get past the bunker.

speaker: Chris
text: Command will send everything. You know that, right?

speaker: Chris
text: Nice try. The vault's still shut.

speaker: Chris
text: Should've... stayed a clerk...

speaker: Chris
text: Tell them... the generator...

speaker: Chris
text: Cold... it's cold...

speaker: Chris
text: The rations have a date stamped on them. I won't say which year.

speaker: Chris
text: Truck needs a new tyre. Truck needs a new truck.

speaker: Chris
text: If I hear that radio jingle one more time I'll eat the radio.

speaker: Chris
text: Found a scorpion in my boot. Named him Corporal.

speaker: Chris
text: Command sent a memo about morale. It was four pages.

speaker: Chris
text: The sandbags have sand in them. That's about the only thing that works here.

speaker: Chris
text: Somebody's growing tomatoes behind the bunker. Good on them.

speaker: Chris
text: My letters home take a month. My mum's replies take two.

speaker: Chris
text: They say the vault's got gold in it. They say a lot.

speaker: Chris
text: I've cleaned this rifle so often it's thinner than when I got it.

speaker: Chris
text: Grenade out!

speaker: Chris
text: He's on the roof!

speaker: Chris
text: Through the window! He's at the window!

speaker: Chris
text: Fall back to the next room!

speaker: Chris
text: Watch your crossfire!

speaker: Chris
text: Get the heavy gun on him!

speaker: Chris
text: Visitor at the fence! Not a friendly one!

speaker: Chris
text: Sound off! Intruder, west bunker!

speaker: Brian

speaker: Brian
text: They give me the big gun because I don't drop it.

speaker: Brian
text: Twelve stone of armour and they still send me up the stairs.

speaker: Brian
text: The plate's warm in summer. Very warm.

speaker: Brian
text: Recruits keep asking if it hurts. Only when I laugh.

speaker: Brian
text: I polish it every night. It's good company.

speaker: Brian
text: Found one.

speaker: Brian
text: There you are.

speaker: Brian
text: Stay right there. I'm slow, but I arrive.

speaker: Brian
text: Contact. Bringing the big one.

speaker: Brian
text: Send them all. I'll wait.

speaker: Brian
text: Keep walking at me. I dare you.

speaker: Brian
text: Is that all you've got?

speaker: Brian
text: Suppressing. Go round him.

speaker: Brian
text: Spinning up. Get behind me.

speaker: Brian
text: Stand still and this goes quicker.

speaker: Brian
text: Your rounds bounce off me. Try harder.

speaker: Brian
text: That tickled.

speaker: Brian
text: Plate's dented. You're not.

speaker: Brian
text: Bring something bigger.

speaker: Brian
text: Hm. That one I felt.

speaker: Brian
text: Plate's cracked. Doesn't matter.

speaker: Brian
text: Lucky shot. Try again.

speaker: Brian
text: Heavy... plate...

speaker: Brian
text: Huh. Didn't think... you'd manage it.

speaker: Brian
text: They built the stairs for lighter men.

speaker: Brian
text: I asked for a smaller gun once. They laughed.

speaker: Brian
text: I'll walk through you.

speaker: Brian
text: Keep shooting. I'll keep coming.
